title: jhum-mapper: code and reference data for annual jhum mapping in Mizoram (1989-2025)
description:
Google Earth Engine code and reference data for mapping annual shifting-cultivation (jhum) clearing from harmonized Landsat 5/7/8/9 with a two-branch rule on symmetric anniversary composites of the Normalized Burn Ratio. Independently validated with blind stratified samples in two sensor eras: 310 PlanetScope-interpreted points for 2025 (overall accuracy 0.995, user's 0.886, producer's 0.901) and 160 points for 2010 (0.996, 0.983, 0.812). Includes the final mapping script, a standalone mapping tool, the annual area series 1989-2025, calibration and validation points, experiment inputs and the reference interpretation protocol.
